178:
[Partial translation]
"With him was Oholiav, son of Achisamach, of the tribe of Dan": This one is from the left side, this one is from the side of strict (another version, holy) judgement. Behold, they explained it, that the tabernacle was made from these two sides, and was established by them to be connected with them in order to be between right and left. And behold, it was said and explained.
184:
[Partial translation]
Rabi Aba said to him: And this cow is sacred, this [cow] is pure, and why? He answered this is so, and the cow is established, it includes four reigns. "Cow", as it says "For Israel is stubborn like a stubborn cow" (Hosea 4:16). "Red" this is the reign of Bavel, as it says "You are a head of gold" (Daniel 2:38). "Unblemished", this is the reign of Persia."without any defects", this is the reign of Greece (because they come close to the ways of faith). "On which no yoke has been laid", this is the reign of Edom, in which no yoke has been laid. And the secret of this thing, even though there are many words in this midrash, all of them are one.
190: Come and behold, "Moses speaks" from what is written, (Shir Hashirim 1:15) "Behold, you are fair my love" and written, (Shir Hashirim 4:3) "Like a strand of scarlet, your lips are." And God (Elohim) answers him by voice, as written, (Shir Hashirim 1:16) "Behold, you are handsome my beloved yes, you are pleasant" and written, (Shir Hashirim 5:13) "His lips are like lillies, dripping flowing myrrh"
196:
[Partial translation]
And the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting — as behold when the cloud covered the Tabernacle, the divine presence rested upon the earth and the spirit of impurity, which is the 'End of All Flesh,' was removed and went into the hole of the great abyss. Then the spirit of holiness rested upon the world, as it is written: And the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting.

And it is written: Moses could not enter the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud had settled upon it. As the holy spirit rested upon the world and the spirit of impurity was removed, so long as those guilty do not pull it back to the world as before. For if they do not pull it back to the world, it will not be found.
